phase.title: Resolve semantic worklist
phase.description: Repeat role stamping, field/evidence acquisition, kind classification and owned-value construction until stable.
details: Role stamping — apply each ENTITY field's declared target class
Reachability — rescan the graph after every newly loaded or owned value
Evidence acquisition — fetch all newly reachable declared properties together
Nominee acquisition slice — P31, P734, P735, P1477, P1559, P742, P569, P570, P18, P27
Person acquisition slice — P1477, P1559, P742, P569, P570, P18, P27, P31
Name acquisition slice — P734, P735, P31
Kind classification — combine stored evidence with missing remote evidence
Owned construction — materialize owner-QID components after kinds settle
Person ← P31 in Q5 — candidates from Nominee.type

explanation.purpose: Close the semantic gap between records discovered from Wikidata and the typed object graph promised by the model.
inputs: Reachable entities and statement records produced so far
Declared target classes on entity-valued fields
Persisted field coverage and retained Wikidata facts
operations: Preflight all currently knowable ⟨entity QID, property⟩ demands before acquisition
Stamp role membership from configured field targets
Acquire newly demanded properties in model-derived bundles
Classify entity kinds from configured evidence rules
Construct owned values that inherit their owner's QID
Repeat until no stamp, value, kind or owned component changes
outputs: Owned components connected to their owners
Retention plans protecting facts that a later semantic operation will consume
A fixed-point object graph ready for final labels and validation
